name: groundwork
description: Turn a rough repository idea into a decision-complete implementation: read the code first, then work the decision tree in rounds until nothing material is left assumed, and only then implement and verify.

interface.shortDescription: Settle the decisions. Build with a clear brief.
interface.longDescription: Read the repository, resolve material decisions through native question forms, confirm the scope, then implement and verify the result.
defaultPrompt: Use $settle to inspect this repository and help me decide what to improve.
Use $settle to clarify this task through native questions, then implement and verify the agreed result.
